metadata.title: Email Campaign Platform SSPP - Advancement Communications
metadata.remarks: Instance SSPP for the Advancement Communications Envoke tenant. This SSPP instantiates the Email Campaign Platform SSPP Template and references authoritative institutional SSPPs.

import-profile.remarks: Imports the Email Campaign Platform SSPP Template and its normative trust and regulatory assertions.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional email campaign platform instance supporting Advancement Communications campaigns.

components.title: Email Campaign Platform (Envoke)
components.description: SaaS email campaign platform implementing the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway pattern.

links.text: Implements the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway pattern.
Inherits technical controls from the Envoke Platform SSPP.

components.remarks: Opt-out enforcement, campaign audit logging, suppression lists, and delivery tracking are native to Envoke and configured per institutional standards.

components.title: Institutional Identity (Entra ID)

links.text: Uses Entra ID for authentication and role assignment.

components.remarks: Roles are mapped to HRIS-backed Entra ID groups.

links.text: Uses institutional SPF, DKIM, and DMARC controls.

components.title: Advancement CRM (Consent Authority)
components.remarks: Consent and audience eligibility are exchanged via an approved data-exchange agreement.

roles.title: Branding / Communications Approver
roles.remarks: Mapped to Institutional Comms group COMM-BRANDING-APPROVER.

control-implementation.remarks: All control requirements are satisfied via imported SSPPs and inherited institutional services. Local configuration is limited to integration and role mapping.
